visualReview.method: Visually inspected all three actual Penpot row exports and the full comparison PNG.
findings: Exactly three additional designs, with one initial-state bar each; the R047 boards are retained.
No separate colour per tag; text, icons and borders use the shared ink/parchment palette.
All eight tag names and glyphs are legible and aligned with equal spans, without percentage labels or a repeated legend.
Ruler precision targets are small edge notches; tackle targets are short stitches; Lantern Focus exposes only the current zone's guide.
Markers remain independent and do not obscure tag labels. The lantern needle is above the text panel; the tackle float is below it.
Native geometry audit confirms 24 equal tag regions, centered proportional precision shapes and one marker per design.
visualReview.scope: Static Penpot designs only; no motion, encounter selection, resizing algorithm or Unity implementation.
